reviewer: Internal research engineering gate, not independent scientific qualification
rationale: Predeclared before fitting this panel. First-tier molecular binding research only: at least 30 in-domain scaffold-held-out molecules, positive rank information and disclosed log-molar prediction error. Broad intervals are retained; satisfying these thresholds does not justify a physiological or safety conclusion.
limitations: Internal scaffold-held-out validation is not an independent prospective biological validation study.
A one-log RMSE ceiling permits approximately an order-of-magnitude concentration error; it is not precise potency qualification.
The 0.8 observed marginal coverage floor does not establish 0.9 coverage under distribution shift or joint coverage across targets.
Nominal binding assays do not establish functional modulation or unbound-tissue potency.
Models failing any gate remain visible but cannot issue accepted numerical candidate predictions.
